name: The Lamp Keeper's Cottage
story: Tamsin wakes the sul-stone every dusk and turns it all night, and once, nine years ago, did not, and a fishing smack found the shingle the hard way. She says she was asleep. The gulls disagree, and so does the second logbook.
who_was_here: Six keepers before her, all of whom kept one logbook.
unique_object: two logbooks for the same nine years, kept in different handwriting by the same hand
